# == DO NOT EDIT THE FOLLOWING LINES for the Raspberry Pi Pico VS Code Extension to work ==
if(WIN32)
    set(USERHOME $ENV{USERPROFILE})
else()
    set(USERHOME $ENV{HOME})
endif()
set(sdkVersion 2.3.1)
set(toolchainVersion RISCV_PICO_2_3_1_0)
set(picotoolVersion 2.3.1)
set(picoVscode ${USERHOME}/.pico-sdk/cmake/pico-vscode.cmake)
if (EXISTS ${picoVscode})
    include(${picoVscode})
endif()
# ====================================================================================
set(PICO_BOARD waveshare_rp2350_tiny CACHE STRING "Board type")

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.13)
include(pico_sdk_import.cmake)
include(pico_extras_import.cmake)
project(travel-companion C CXX ASM)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
pico_sdk_init()

add_subdirectory(drivers/bme680)
add_subdirectory(drivers/SSD1351U3)
add_subdirectory(drivers/ds3231)
add_subdirectory(drivers/sht40)
add_subdirectory(drivers/neo6m)
add_library(timezone STATIC timezone.c)
add_library(datetime_utils STATIC datetime_utils.c)
add_library(time_sync STATIC time_sync.c)
target_link_libraries(time_sync PUBLIC ds3231 neo6m)
target_link_libraries(datetime_utils PUBLIC ds3231 PRIVATE timezone)
add_library(power STATIC power.c)
target_link_libraries(power PUBLIC hardware_sleep hardware_gpio pico_stdlib hardware_clocks)
add_library(buttons STATIC buttons.c)
target_link_libraries(buttons PUBLIC pico_stdlib hardware_gpio hardware_sync board_config)
add_library(ui STATIC ui.c)
target_link_libraries(ui PUBLIC ssd1351 ds3231 neo6m datetime_utils board_config)
add_executable(travel-companion main.c)
target_link_libraries(travel-companion pico_stdlib hardware_i2c bme680_port ssd1351_port ds3231_port sht40_port neo6m_port timezone datetime_utils power hardware_clocks buttons ui time_sync)
add_library(board_config INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(board_config INTERFACE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR})

pico_enable_stdio_usb(travel-companion 1)
pico_enable_stdio_uart(travel-companion 0)
pico_add_extra_outputs(travel-companion)
